title: Gemma 4 QAT models: Optimizing compression for mobile and laptop efficiency
summary: Google released Gemma 4 models featuring Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) technology, specifically optimized for deployment on mobile devices and laptops. This approach allows models to maintain higher quality while being compressed to run efficiently on resource-constrained hardware.
problem_solved: Enables running large language models on mobile and laptop devices without significant quality degradation from aggressive quantization.
why_valuable: QAT provides a better accuracy-to-compression ratio than post-training quantization, making powerful AI models accessible on everyday consumer hardware.
